about: Design 140: the oldest Vibb server a launcher or music build needs, a file inside the signed APK. Gradle writes the value and one newline to 'entry' in every build (launcher/app/build.gradle.kts, music/app/build.gradle.kts: -PminServer from scripts/min-server.sh in a tag build, else server/Cargo.toml's version), and fails on a value 'value_format' refuses. The server (apk::read_min_server) reads at most 'max_bytes' + 1 bytes: more than 'max_bytes', or anything but the value with at most one trailing newline, is unreadable. A release of ours at or above 'launcher_first' / 'music_first' (read as versionCodes by launcher_tag_codes.json's rule) without a readable value is refused; one below it carries none and is served as before. 'files': an entry's text and the version it reads as, null = unreadable. Kept in contracts/music/ because the server, the launcher and the music app all read it and only that folder is in all three workflows' filters.
